54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.action: Export the PostgreSQL logs to CloudWatch Logs.
54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.title: Database logs aren't collected in one place
54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.what_could_happen: Slow queries, failed logins and schema changes can't be seen or alerted on.

5b7be8d8-05f5-46f4-b216-41d31f80b57e.action: Restrict ingress to specific CIDR ranges, a bastion, or use SSM Session Manager.
5b7be8d8-05f5-46f4-b216-41d31f80b57e.subject: rds
5b7be8d8-05f5-46f4-b216-41d31f80b57e.title: Security group 'rds' allows SSH or RDP from anywhere
5b7be8d8-05f5-46f4-b216-41d31f80b57e.what_could_happen: Remote administration ports are reachable from the entire internet.

9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.action: Let Aurora add reader copies automatically at busy times and remove them afterwards.
9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.title: The database can't add capacity for deadline rushes
9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.what_could_happen: During filing deadlines the public website and API could slow down or fail to connect.

a2192a0b-4448-40bf-afb3-fbb2414cf994.action: Add an aws_cloudtrail resource covering all regions with log file validation enabled.
a2192a0b-4448-40bf-afb3-fbb2414cf994.title: No aws_cloudtrail resource found in the submitted Terraform
a2192a0b-4448-40bf-afb3-fbb2414cf994.what_could_happen: API activity in the account would not be recorded for audit/incident response.

bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.action: Keep production backups for 14 to 35 days.
bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.title: Backups only reach back one week
bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.what_could_happen: A data problem found after 7 days can't be rolled back from the automatic backups.

d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.action: Send database events to an alert topic the operations team watches.
d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.title: No one is alerted when the database fails over
d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.what_could_happen: A failover or failed backup during a filing rush could go unnoticed until users complain.

d89d7166-f861-44af-9d84-2cd0ecc5b048.action: Set publicly_accessible = false and reach the database from inside the VPC.
d89d7166-f861-44af-9d84-2cd0ecc5b048.subject: development_aurora_inst
d89d7166-f861-44af-9d84-2cd0ecc5b048.title: RDS instance 'development_aurora_inst' is publicly accessible
d89d7166-f861-44af-9d84-2cd0ecc5b048.what_could_happen: The database gets a public endpoint and is one security-group mistake from the internet.

dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.action: Optional: switch to a customer-managed key for tighter control.
dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.title: Database storage is encrypted
dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.what_could_happen: Little: stored data is protected. A customer-managed key would add control over who can decrypt it.

e3ebb27e-03c8-436b-9a64-e6cae1f0b1b0.action: Set publicly_accessible = false and reach the database from inside the VPC.
e3ebb27e-03c8-436b-9a64-e6cae1f0b1b0.subject: production_aurora_inst
e3ebb27e-03c8-436b-9a64-e6cae1f0b1b0.title: RDS instance 'production_aurora_inst' is publicly accessible
e3ebb27e-03c8-436b-9a64-e6cae1f0b1b0.what_could_happen: The database gets a public endpoint and is one security-group mistake from the internet.

e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.action: Optional: add a subnet in a third data center so the three copies spread out.
e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.title: The production database uses two data centers, not three
e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.what_could_happen: It already meets the multi-data-center check and survives losing one. Spreading the three copies over a third would keep more read capacity during an outage.

e8e69ea5-4b46-4bf0-bb12-154e54867dca.action: Set publicly_accessible = false and reach the database from inside the VPC.
e8e69ea5-4b46-4bf0-bb12-154e54867dca.subject: staging_aurora_inst
e8e69ea5-4b46-4bf0-bb12-154e54867dca.title: RDS instance 'staging_aurora_inst' is publicly accessible
e8e69ea5-4b46-4bf0-bb12-154e54867dca.what_could_happen: The database gets a public endpoint and is one security-group mistake from the internet.

eaaf6979-2db2-4f5c-9f49-9027b8fcbd99.action: Restrict ingress to specific CIDR ranges or a bastion/VPN security group.
eaaf6979-2db2-4f5c-9f49-9027b8fcbd99.subject: rds
eaaf6979-2db2-4f5c-9f49-9027b8fcbd99.title: Security group rule 'rds' allows 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to sensitive port(s) [1433, 3306, 5432, 6379, 9200, 27017]
eaaf6979-2db2-4f5c-9f49-9027b8fcbd99.what_could_happen: Sensitive management/database ports are reachable from the entire internet.

f0c95c6a-2aa1-4dec-8d6a-cc2faebf69dd.title: Backup labels are already copied
f0c95c6a-2aa1-4dec-8d6a-cc2faebf69dd.what_could_happen: Nothing: all three clusters already copy tags to their snapshots. The reviewer corrected this finding.

f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.action: Turn on IAM database sign-in so each app uses its own short-lived token, and turn on the database's own connection logging. CloudTrail doesn't record these sign-ins.
f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.title: Database sign-in isn't tied to each app's identity
f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.what_could_happen: Apps sign in with database passwords. A leaked password keeps working until someone changes it, and nothing in the code ties a connection to a specific app or person.
